results.text: Safety assessment of ezetimibe: real-world adverse event analysis from the FAERS database. Ezetimibe is known for its lipid-lowering safety and tolerability, but its real-world adverse effects have not been fully evaluated. In this study, adverse events associated with ezetimibe were investigated using the FAERS database for the period 2004 to 2023.
